name: Campingplatz Kaseler
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Kaseler is located in the valley basin of Ginzling, a small village in the Zillertal. The site offers pitches for motorhomes and tents in the immediate vicinity of the river. From here, guests can reach hiking trails and mountain bike routes into the rear Zillertal. The sanitary facilities are functionally equipped. In the village there is an inn and a small shop.
